It delivers superior bonding strength for anchoring bolts, rebars, and threaded rods into concrete and masonry surfaces. This advanced epoxy mortar provides excellent load-bearing capacity and ensures secure fixation even under heavy structural stress. The fast-curing formula helps reduce installation time, allowing projects to move forward efficiently without compromising safety. The injectable design allows smooth, controlled application using standard caulking guns, ensuring proper mixing, easy handling, and minimal material wastage. Once cured, the bond offers high resistance to vibration, pull-out forces, and environmental wear.
